_comment: Hand-edited names and descriptions. Fields here override parts/head.generated.json (which tools/build_head_zanatomy.py rewrites). Keys are part ids, shown in the info panel.

accessory_branch_of_middle_meningeal_art.description: A small branch of the middle meningeal artery that passes through the foramen ovale to supply the pterygoid muscles, the auditory tube and the trigeminal ganglion region.
A small branch of the middle meningeal artery that passes through the foramen ovale to supply the pterygoid muscles, the auditory tube and the trigeminal ganglion region.

ampulla_of_lacrimal_canaliculus_left.description: The small dilation at the bend of each lacrimal canaliculus, the channel that carries tears from the eyelid margin to the lacrimal sac.

ampulla_of_lacrimal_canaliculus_right.description: The small dilation at the bend of each lacrimal canaliculus, the channel that carries tears from the eyelid margin to the lacrimal sac.

anterior_cells_of_ethmoid_bone_left.description: The front group of air cells in the ethmoidal labyrinth, draining into the middle meatus of the nose.

anterior_cells_of_ethmoid_bone_right.description: The front group of air cells in the ethmoidal labyrinth, draining into the middle meatus of the nose.

anterior_deep_temporal_artery_left.description: A branch of the maxillary artery that runs up deep to the temporalis muscle, supplying it and anastomosing with the lacrimal artery.

anterior_deep_temporal_artery_right.description: A branch of the maxillary artery that runs up deep to the temporalis muscle, supplying it and anastomosing with the lacrimal artery.

anterior_occipital_sulcus_left.name: Anterior occipital sulcus (left)
anterior_occipital_sulcus_left.description: A variable groove on the lateral surface separating the occipital lobe from the temporal and parietal lobes.

anterior_occipital_sulcus_right.name: Anterior occipital sulcus (right)
anterior_occipital_sulcus_right.description: A variable groove on the lateral surface separating the occipital lobe from the temporal and parietal lobes.

anterior_quadrangular_lobule_left.description: The front part of the cerebellar hemisphere's upper surface, lying in front of the primary fissure (part of the anterior lobe).

anterior_quadrangular_lobule_right.description: The front part of the cerebellar hemisphere's upper surface, lying in front of the primary fissure (part of the anterior lobe).

anterior_septal_branches_of_anterior_eth.description: Small branches of the anterior ethmoidal artery that supply the front and upper part of the nasal septum.
Small branches of the anterior ethmoidal artery that supply the front and upper part of the nasal septum.

anterior_temporal_branch_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that supplies the front of the temporal lobe.

anterior_temporal_branch_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that supplies the front of the temporal lobe.

apex_of_auricle_left.description: The upper tip of the helix of the external ear.

apex_of_auricle_right.description: The upper tip of the helix of the external ear.

aqueduct_of_midbrain.description: The narrow channel through the midbrain connecting the third and fourth ventricles, carrying cerebrospinal fluid.

artery_of_central_sulcus_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that runs in the central sulcus, supplying the motor and sensory cortex on either side.

artery_of_central_sulcus_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that runs in the central sulcus, supplying the motor and sensory cortex on either side.

artery_of_precentral_sulcus_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that follows the precentral sulcus and supplies the premotor area.

artery_of_precentral_sulcus_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that follows the precentral sulcus and supplies the premotor area.

artery_of_pterygoid_canal_left.description: A small branch of the maxillary artery that runs back through the pterygoid canal to supply the upper pharynx and auditory tube.

artery_of_pterygoid_canal_right.description: A small branch of the maxillary artery that runs back through the pterygoid canal to supply the upper pharynx and auditory tube.

auricular_tubercle_left.description: A small projection on the upper back part of the helix (Darwin's tubercle), present in some people.

auricular_tubercle_right.description: A small projection on the upper back part of the helix (Darwin's tubercle), present in some people.

base_of_peduncle_left.description: The front part of the cerebral peduncle (crus cerebri) in the midbrain, carrying descending motor fibres.

base_of_peduncle_right.description: The front part of the cerebral peduncle (crus cerebri) in the midbrain, carrying descending motor fibres.

biventral_lobule_left.description: A lobule on the underside of the cerebellar hemisphere, lying in front of the tonsil.

biventral_lobule_right.description: A lobule on the underside of the cerebellar hemisphere, lying in front of the tonsil.

branch_to_angular_gyrus_left.description: The terminal cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery, supplying the angular gyrus of the parietal lobe.

branch_to_angular_gyrus_right.description: The terminal cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery, supplying the angular gyrus of the parietal lobe.

central_canal.name: Central canal
central_canal.description: The narrow fluid-filled canal that continues from the fourth ventricle down through the medulla and spinal cord.

ciliary_body_curve_right.name: Ciliary body (right)
ciliary_body_curve_right.description: The ring of muscle and folded tissue behind the iris. It makes aqueous humour and changes the shape of the lens to focus.

cingulate_gyrus_and_sulcus_posterior_dor.description: The back upper part of the cingulate gyrus on the medial surface of the hemisphere, involved in attention and spatial memory.
The back upper part of the cingulate gyrus on the medial surface of the hemisphere, involved in attention and spatial memory.

declive.description: A part of the cerebellar vermis just behind the primary fissure, continuous with the simple lobule.

distal_lateral_striate_branches_left.description: Lenticulostriate arteries arising from the middle cerebral artery that pierce the base of the brain to supply the basal ganglia and internal capsule.

distal_lateral_striate_branches_right.description: Lenticulostriate arteries arising from the middle cerebral artery that pierce the base of the brain to supply the basal ganglia and internal capsule.

eminentia_conchae_left.description: The bulge on the back of the auricle that corresponds to the hollow of the concha on the front.

eminentia_conchae_right.description: The bulge on the back of the auricle that corresponds to the hollow of the concha on the front.

eminentia_fossae_triangularis_left.description: The bulge on the back of the auricle corresponding to the triangular fossa on the front.

eminentia_fossae_triangularis_right.description: The bulge on the back of the auricle corresponding to the triangular fossa on the front.

eminentia_scaphae_left.description: The bulge on the back of the auricle corresponding to the scapha, the groove behind the helix.

eminentia_scaphae_right.description: The bulge on the back of the auricle corresponding to the scapha, the groove behind the helix.

folium_of_vermis.description: A small leaf-like part of the cerebellar vermis between the declive and the tuber.

frontal_branch_of_superficial_temporal_a.description: One of the two terminal branches of the superficial temporal artery, running forward across the temple to supply the scalp and forehead.
One of the two terminal branches of the superficial temporal artery, running forward across the temple to supply the scalp and forehead.

frontal_branches_of_callosomarginal_arte.description: Branches of the callosomarginal artery, itself a branch of the anterior cerebral artery, supplying the medial surface of the frontal lobe.
Branches of the callosomarginal artery, itself a branch of the anterior cerebral artery, supplying the medial surface of the frontal lobe.

globus_pallidus_left.description: The inner part of the lentiform nucleus in the basal ganglia. It is the main output station that regulates voluntary movement.

globus_pallidus_right.description: The inner part of the lentiform nucleus in the basal ganglia. It is the main output station that regulates voluntary movement.

gracile_lobule_left.description: A lobule on the underside of the cerebellar hemisphere (paramedian lobule), between the inferior semilunar and biventral lobules.

gracile_lobule_right.description: A lobule on the underside of the cerebellar hemisphere (paramedian lobule), between the inferior semilunar and biventral lobules.

inferior_semilunar_lobule_left.description: A crescent-shaped lobule on the underside of the cerebellar hemisphere (crus II of the ansiform lobule).

inferior_semilunar_lobule_right.description: A crescent-shaped lobule on the underside of the cerebellar hemisphere (crus II of the ansiform lobule).

infra_auricular_nodes_left.description: Lymph nodes just below the ear, part of the parotid group, draining the scalp, ear and side of the face.

infra_auricular_nodes_right.description: Lymph nodes just below the ear, part of the parotid group, draining the scalp, ear and side of the face.

infra_orbital_region_left.description: The surface region of the face below the orbit and beside the nose, overlying the maxilla.

infra_orbital_region_right.description: The surface region of the face below the orbit and beside the nose, overlying the maxilla.

insular_branches_of_middle_cerebral_arte.description: The M2 segment of the middle cerebral artery, whose branches run over the insula deep within the lateral sulcus.

insular_branches_of_middle_cerebral_arte.name: Insular branches of middle cerebral artery (M2) (left)
insular_branches_of_middle_cerebral_arte.description: The M2 segment of the middle cerebral artery, whose branches run over the insula deep within the lateral sulcus.

intraglandular_parotid_nodes_left.description: Lymph nodes embedded within the parotid gland, draining the forehead, temple, eyelids and external ear.

intraglandular_parotid_nodes_right.description: Lymph nodes embedded within the parotid gland, draining the forehead, temple, eyelids and external ear.

lat_fis_ant_horizont_left.name: Anterior horizontal ramus of lateral sulcus (left)
lat_fis_ant_horizont_left.description: The short forward branch of the lateral (Sylvian) fissure, bordering the triangular and orbital parts of the inferior frontal gyrus.

lat_fis_ant_horizont_right.name: Anterior horizontal ramus of lateral sulcus (right)
lat_fis_ant_horizont_right.description: The short forward branch of the lateral (Sylvian) fissure, bordering the triangular and orbital parts of the inferior frontal gyrus.

lat_fis_ant_vertical_left.name: Anterior ascending ramus of lateral sulcus (left)
lat_fis_ant_vertical_left.description: The short upward branch of the lateral fissure separating the triangular and opercular parts of the inferior frontal gyrus.

lat_fis_ant_vertical_right.name: Anterior ascending ramus of lateral sulcus (right)
lat_fis_ant_vertical_right.description: The short upward branch of the lateral fissure separating the triangular and opercular parts of the inferior frontal gyrus.

lat_fis_post_left.name: Posterior ramus of lateral sulcus (left)
lat_fis_post_left.description: The long main branch of the lateral fissure, separating the temporal lobe below from the frontal and parietal lobes above.

lat_fis_post_right.name: Posterior ramus of lateral sulcus (right)
lat_fis_post_right.description: The long main branch of the lateral fissure, separating the temporal lobe below from the frontal and parietal lobes above.

lateral_frontobasal_artery_left.description: A branch of the middle cerebral artery (also called the lateral orbitofrontal artery) that supplies the underside of the frontal lobe.

lateral_frontobasal_artery_right.description: A branch of the middle cerebral artery (also called the lateral orbitofrontal artery) that supplies the underside of the frontal lobe.

lateral_pontine_branches_of_basilar_arte.description: Small branches of the basilar artery that supply the lateral part of the pons.
Small branches of the basilar artery that supply the lateral part of the pons.

lateral_superior_jugular_node_left.description: A deep cervical lymph node along the upper internal jugular vein, receiving lymph from much of the head.

lateral_superior_jugular_node_right.description: A deep cervical lymph node along the upper internal jugular vein, receiving lymph from much of the head.

lentiform_nucleus_left.description: A lens-shaped mass of grey matter in the basal ganglia, made up of the putamen and the globus pallidus.

lentiform_nucleus_right.description: A lens-shaped mass of grey matter in the basal ganglia, made up of the putamen and the globus pallidus.

lingual_gyrus_left.description: A gyrus on the medial surface of the occipital lobe below the calcarine sulcus, involved in visual processing.

lingual_gyrus_right.description: A gyrus on the medial surface of the occipital lobe below the calcarine sulcus, involved in visual processing.

lingual_vein_left.description: A vein draining the tongue, running with the lingual artery and emptying into the internal jugular vein.

lingual_vein_right.description: A vein draining the tongue, running with the lingual artery and emptying into the internal jugular vein.

mamillary_body_left.description: A pair of small round bodies on the underside of the hypothalamus, part of the circuit for memory (the Papez circuit).

mamillary_body_right.description: A pair of small round bodies on the underside of the hypothalamus, part of the circuit for memory (the Papez circuit).

medial_pontine_branches_of_basilar_arter.description: Short paramedian branches of the basilar artery that supply the medial part of the pons.
Short paramedian branches of the basilar artery that supply the medial part of the pons.

mental_branch_of_inferior_alveolar_arter.description: The terminal branch of the inferior alveolar artery that leaves the mandible through the mental foramen to supply the chin and lower lip.
The terminal branch of the inferior alveolar artery that leaves the mandible through the mental foramen to supply the chin and lower lip.

middle_cells_of_ethmoid_bone_left.description: The middle group of ethmoidal air cells, opening into the middle meatus of the nose.

middle_cells_of_ethmoid_bone_right.description: The middle group of ethmoidal air cells, opening into the middle meatus of the nose.

middle_cerebral_artery_m3_segment_left.description: The opercular segment of the middle cerebral artery, where its branches loop over the frontal, parietal and temporal opercula towards the surface.

middle_cerebral_artery_m3_segment_right.name: Middle cerebral artery (M3 segment) (right)
middle_cerebral_artery_m3_segment_right.description: The opercular segment of the middle cerebral artery, where its branches loop over the frontal, parietal and temporal opercula towards the surface.

mucosa_of_nasal_cavity.description: The mucous membrane lining the nasal cavity. It warms, moistens and filters inhaled air, and contains the olfactory area in its roof.

mylohyoid_branch_of_inferior_alveolar_ar.description: A branch of the inferior alveolar artery that runs in the mylohyoid groove of the mandible with the nerve to mylohyoid, supplying the mylohyoid muscle.
A branch of the inferior alveolar artery that runs in the mylohyoid groove of the mandible with the nerve to mylohyoid, supplying the mylohyoid muscle.

nerve_to_mylohyoid_muscle_left.description: A branch of the inferior alveolar nerve (from the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve) supplying the mylohyoid muscle and the anterior belly of digastric.

nerve_to_mylohyoid_muscle_right.description: A branch of the inferior alveolar nerve (from the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve) supplying the mylohyoid muscle and the anterior belly of digastric.

nucleus_pulposus_c2_c3.description: The gel-like core of the intervertebral disc between the second and third cervical vertebrae, which absorbs compressive load.

nucleus_pulposus_c3_c4.description: The gel-like core of the intervertebral disc between the third and fourth cervical vertebrae.

nucleus_pulposus_c4_c5.description: The gel-like core of the intervertebral disc between the fourth and fifth cervical vertebrae.

occipital_sinus.description: The smallest dural venous sinus, running in the attached margin of the falx cerebelli and draining into the confluence of sinuses.

occipitotemporal_sulcus_lateral_part_lef.name: Occipitotemporal sulcus (lateral part) (left)
occipitotemporal_sulcus_lateral_part_lef.description: The groove on the underside of the temporal and occipital lobes separating the inferior temporal gyrus from the fusiform gyrus.

occipitotemporal_sulcus_lateral_part_rig.name: Occipitotemporal sulcus (lateral part) (right)
occipitotemporal_sulcus_lateral_part_rig.description: The groove on the underside of the temporal and occipital lobes separating the inferior temporal gyrus from the fusiform gyrus.

orbitofrontal_branches_of_anterior_cereb.description: Branches of the anterior cerebral artery supplying the orbital (under) surface of the frontal lobe and the olfactory region.
Branches of the anterior cerebral artery supplying the orbital (under) surface of the frontal lobe and the olfactory region.

paracentral_sulcus_left.description: A groove on the medial surface of the hemisphere marking the front edge of the paracentral lobule.

paracentral_sulcus_right.description: A groove on the medial surface of the hemisphere marking the front edge of the paracentral lobule.

parietal_branches_of_middle_cerebral_art.description: Cortical branches of the middle cerebral artery supplying the lateral surface of the parietal lobe.
Cortical branches of the middle cerebral artery supplying the lateral surface of the parietal lobe.

parotideomasseteric_region_left.description: The surface region of the side of the face over the parotid gland and masseter muscle, in front of the ear.

parotideomasseteric_region_right.description: The surface region of the side of the face over the parotid gland and masseter muscle, in front of the ear.

peduncle_of_flocculus_left.description: The stalk connecting the flocculus to the nodule of the vermis, part of the vestibular cerebellum.

peduncle_of_flocculus_right.description: The stalk connecting the flocculus to the nodule of the vermis, part of the vestibular cerebellum.

postcentral_arterial_branch_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that runs along the postcentral sulcus, supplying sensory cortex.

postcentral_arterial_branch_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that runs along the postcentral sulcus, supplying sensory cortex.

posterior_cells_of_ethmoid_bone_left.description: The back group of ethmoidal air cells, opening into the superior meatus of the nose.

posterior_cells_of_ethmoid_bone_right.description: The back group of ethmoidal air cells, opening into the superior meatus of the nose.

posterior_deep_temporal_artery_left.description: A branch of the maxillary artery that ascends between the temporalis muscle and the skull to supply the back of the muscle.

posterior_deep_temporal_artery_right.description: A branch of the maxillary artery that ascends between the temporalis muscle and the skull to supply the back of the muscle.

posterior_lateral_nasal_branches_of_sphe.name: Posterior lateral nasal branches of sphenopalatine artery (left)
posterior_lateral_nasal_branches_of_sphe.description: Branches of the sphenopalatine artery supplying the conchae and lateral wall of the nasal cavity, a common source of posterior nosebleeds.

posterior_lateral_nasal_branches_of_sphe.name: Posterior lateral nasal branches of sphenopalatine artery (right)
posterior_lateral_nasal_branches_of_sphe.description: Branches of the sphenopalatine artery supplying the conchae and lateral wall of the nasal cavity, a common source of posterior nosebleeds.

posterior_parietal_artery_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery supplying the inferior and superior parietal lobules.

posterior_parietal_artery_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery supplying the inferior and superior parietal lobules.

posterior_quadrangular_lobule_left.description: The part of the upper cerebellar hemisphere just behind the primary fissure (the simple lobule).

posterior_quadrangular_lobule_right.description: The part of the upper cerebellar hemisphere just behind the primary fissure (the simple lobule).

posterior_temporal_branch_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that supplies the back of the superior and middle temporal gyri.

posterior_temporal_branch_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery that supplies the back of the superior and middle temporal gyri.

posterior_transverse_collateral_sulcus_l.description: A small variable groove at the back of the collateral sulcus on the underside of the hemisphere.

posterior_transverse_collateral_sulcus_r.description: A small variable groove at the back of the collateral sulcus on the underside of the hemisphere.

pre_auricular_nodes_left.description: Lymph nodes in front of the tragus of the ear, draining the eyelids, temple and front of the ear. They can swell with eye infections.

pre_auricular_nodes_right.description: Lymph nodes in front of the tragus of the ear, draining the eyelids, temple and front of the ear. They can swell with eye infections.

prefrontal_artery_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery supplying the lateral prefrontal cortex.

prefrontal_artery_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery supplying the lateral prefrontal cortex.

proximal_lateral_striate_branches_left.description: The first lenticulostriate branches of the middle cerebral artery, supplying the basal ganglia and internal capsule. Their occlusion is a common cause of small deep strokes.

proximal_lateral_striate_branches_right.description: The first lenticulostriate branches of the middle cerebral artery, supplying the basal ganglia and internal capsule. Their occlusion is a common cause of small deep strokes.

pyramis_of_vermis.description: A part of the inferior cerebellar vermis between the tuber and the uvula.

rectus_anterior_capitis_muscle_left.description: A short deep neck muscle from the atlas to the base of the occipital bone that flexes the head at the atlanto-occipital joint.

rectus_anterior_capitis_muscle_right.description: A short deep neck muscle from the atlas to the base of the occipital bone that flexes the head at the atlanto-occipital joint.

rectus_lateralis_capitis_muscle_left.description: A short muscle from the transverse process of the atlas to the jugular process of the occipital bone that bends the head to the side.

rectus_lateralis_capitis_muscle_right.description: A short muscle from the transverse process of the atlas to the jugular process of the occipital bone that bends the head to the side.

septal_branches_of_posterior_ethmoidal_a.description: Small branches of the posterior ethmoidal artery supplying the upper back part of the nasal septum.
Small branches of the posterior ethmoidal artery supplying the upper back part of the nasal septum.

short_posterior_ciliary_arteries_left.description: Several small branches of the ophthalmic artery that pierce the sclera around the optic nerve to supply the choroid and optic disc.

short_posterior_ciliary_arteries_right.description: Several small branches of the ophthalmic artery that pierce the sclera around the optic nerve to supply the choroid and optic disc.

sulcus_interm_prim_jensen_left.name: Intermediate sulcus of Jensen (left)
sulcus_interm_prim_jensen_left.description: A variable groove in the inferior parietal lobule separating the supramarginal and angular gyri.

sulcus_interm_prim_jensen_right.name: Intermediate sulcus of Jensen (right)
sulcus_interm_prim_jensen_right.description: A variable groove in the inferior parietal lobule separating the supramarginal and angular gyri.

superficial_parotid_nodes_left.description: Lymph nodes on the surface of the parotid gland in front of the ear, draining the scalp, eyelids and cheek.

superficial_parotid_nodes_right.description: Lymph nodes on the surface of the parotid gland in front of the ear, draining the scalp, eyelids and cheek.

superior_semilunar_lobule_left.description: A crescent-shaped lobule on the back upper surface of the cerebellar hemisphere (crus I of the ansiform lobule).

superior_semilunar_lobule_right.description: A crescent-shaped lobule on the back upper surface of the cerebellar hemisphere (crus I of the ansiform lobule).

superior_thyroid_vein_left.description: A vein draining the upper part of the thyroid gland, accompanying the superior thyroid artery and emptying into the internal jugular vein.

superior_thyroid_vein_right.description: A vein draining the upper part of the thyroid gland, accompanying the superior thyroid artery and emptying into the internal jugular vein.

supra_orbital_artery_left.description: A branch of the ophthalmic artery that leaves the orbit through the supra-orbital notch to supply the forehead and scalp.

supra_orbital_artery_right.description: A branch of the ophthalmic artery that leaves the orbit through the supra-orbital notch to supply the forehead and scalp.

temporal_branches_of_middle_cerebral_art.description: Cortical branches of the middle cerebral artery that supply the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.
Cortical branches of the middle cerebral artery that supply the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.

temporo_occipital_branch_left.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery supplying the junction of the temporal and occipital lobes.

temporo_occipital_branch_right.description: A cortical branch of the middle cerebral artery supplying the junction of the temporal and occipital lobes.

tonsil_of_cerebellum_left.description: A rounded lobule on the underside of each cerebellar hemisphere beside the vermis. Raised pressure can push it into the foramen magnum.

tonsil_of_cerebellum_right.description: A rounded lobule on the underside of each cerebellar hemisphere beside the vermis. Raised pressure can push it into the foramen magnum.

transverse_frontopolar_gyrus_and_sulcus_.name: Transverse frontopolar gyri and sulci (left)
transverse_frontopolar_gyrus_and_sulcus_.description: Small transverse folds at the front pole of the frontal lobe.

transverse_frontopolar_gyrus_and_sulcus_.name: Transverse frontopolar gyri and sulci (right)
transverse_frontopolar_gyrus_and_sulcus_.description: Small transverse folds at the front pole of the frontal lobe.

uvula_of_vermis.description: A part of the inferior cerebellar vermis between the pyramis and the nodule, flanked by the cerebellar tonsils.

wing_of_central_lobule_left.description: The lateral extension of the central lobule of the vermis onto the cerebellar hemisphere.

wing_of_central_lobule_right.description: The lateral extension of the central lobule of the vermis onto the cerebellar hemisphere.
